title: Fix item search failures in order creation; support custom line items
requested_outcome: When adding an item to a new order by name, the same words that already match in variant search must successfully add that item to the order card — right now an active, in-stock item repeatedly fails to add even though variant search finds it, leaving the order card empty. Also, there is currently no way to add a custom or inactive-product line item (for example, ten sticker packs, no longer an active product) to a new or existing order — this needs to become possible, with a title and price at minimum. Nothing else about how orders are built, priced or shown should change.
acceptance_criteria: An active, in-stock product that matches in variant search by name can be added as a line item to a new order without the add failing or the order card staying empty
A custom line item (a title and a price, with no matching product) can be added to a new order
A custom line item (a title and a price, with no matching product) can be added to an existing order
Adding a custom or inactive-product line item does not require or invent a variant_id
The change is proven by tests in crooks-assistant/tests/test_fix_item_search_failures_order_creation.py, and they pass.
